text:
Ava: Hey folks - spontaneous lunchtime "Uphill Striders" challenge today? 12:30 meet by lobby stairs. Quick up/down sprints, or chill uphill walk + coffee for anyone who wants views. :coffee: :mountain:
Diego: Love it. Count me in for the sprints. Can someone time sprints? :stopwatch:
Priya: I'm in for the walk — baby stroller friendly? :)
Sam: I'll bring the FitBot timer and post split times. Also down for a tiny leaderboard: `1) Diego 12s` just kidding but we'll log times.
Walter: If it rains we do stairs inside (4th-floor loop). Also +1 for post-run iced lattes.
Ava: Cool - will DM facilities if we need to block the lobby at 12:25.
Priya: @Ava can you add me to the huddle after? want to sync cadence with the stroller :sweat_smile:
Sam: Quick reminder: 2-3 min dynamic warmup (calves, hip openers) before sprints.
Diego: On sprint note, what's the stair count? 36 to roof?
Ava: 32 to roof, 18 to mezz. We'll use mezz for sprints so folks can bail early.
Walter: See you all! :running: :coffee:
